items.q: And Ed Sullivan would come out of the now here come -- theater

ctx.x: We pick up Walter Winchell. Walter Winchell would be some place else. We go by and pick him up.
And Ed Sullivan would come out of the now here come -- theater and (inaudible). And we go on 52nd Street, we go some place else.
One time we go down to the Village, you know. Walter Winchell would be going around getting his sheet together.
